Here are a few quick examples to get you started using the SpaceX API:

```typescript
// Get the latest SpaceX launch details.
async function getLatestLaunch() {
  const launch = await client.v4.launches.latest();
  console.log(`Latest launch name: ${launch.name}`);
  return launch;
}
```

```typescript
// Retrieve today's Astronomy Picture of the Day.
async function getApod() {
  const apod = await client.planetary.apod();
  console.log(`Today's APOD title: ${apod.title}`);
  console.log(`APOD URL: ${apod.url}`);
  return apod;
}
```
